notice: Results apply only to the hardware, firmware, connection and software listed. Reports from another project do not verify HA Growatt. A successful read does not prove a control works.

entries.firmware: GH1.0 and AL1.0 observed across the pair; model-to-feed mapping unconfirmed
entries.telemetry: Fresh readings, cloud forwarding, MQTT discovery, restart and history preservation verified.
entries.controls: Not physically qualified; no battery qualification.
entries.profile: Retain the installation's working Automatic selection.
entries.limits: The owner identified one inverter as a MIN 2500TL-XH on 21 September 2026. The two feeds jointly preserve 64 measurement entities. Exact model-to-feed mapping, second model and datalogger variants remain unconfirmed. No battery control was physically qualified.

entries.telemetry: Settings readback reported; this AC-coupled storage model has no direct PV input.
entries.controls: ShinePhone-to-HA refresh confirmed by reporter. HA writes had confirmation problems; 0.10.0 adds a fix, with no later reporter confirmation in the checked thread.
entries.profile: SPA readings; SPA battery controls only with experimental controls enabled.
entries.limits: Not tested with HA Growatt. A closed issue is not physical confirmation of the final fix.

entries.datalogger: Waveshare RS485 TO ETH (B) gateway; separate ShineWiFi used for cloud uploads
entries.telemetry: Model-specific register evidence; not a HA Growatt telemetry test.
entries.controls: Reporter measured charging stopping at register 3048 target and discharge changing at register 3067 under Load Priority, on DN1.0. Changes took roughly two minutes. SPH registers 1071/1091 did not control this device.
entries.profile: MOD/MID TL3-XH experimental controls, only after confirming the exact model and successful reads.
entries.limits: Direct Modbus results do not establish support through a Shine datalogger. HA Growatt has no direct Modbus client. Raising the reported discharge threshold above current charge also caused charging on this firmware; do not assume it only stops discharge.

entries.project: Growatt protocol documentation; HA Growatt protocol tests
entries.telemetry: MIN protocol-6 layout implemented; this does not qualify every MIN model.
entries.controls: Charge power 3047, charge limit 3048 and grid charging 3049 are implemented as experimental controls.
entries.profile: MIN readings; MIN TL-XH battery controls only for matching hardware.
entries.limits: No SPH schedules. Reads, write confirmation and physical battery behaviour require separate verification.
